description: Is the market risk-on or risk-off? The gate, step one of a desk's routine: whether the US stock market is worth trading today, read top-down from the index to its sectors. A cash reading means the discipline opens nothing new. The top-down stock market regime read: risk-on, be-selective or stand-down. Returns, for each book (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, macro, BTC/ETH crypto), the regime mode and verdict, the green sectors and the sectors whose names are open to buy. Free sample: headline fields per book, one market day delayed.
name: get_market_regime
